title: Confirm a Gate Change with Lin Muen

skillUnitVariants.communicationGoal: Confirm a changed boarding gate and the next action clearly

commonErrorMappings.correctionFocus: Repeat the new gate and ask when boarding starts

evidenceCriteria.description: States or confirms the new boarding gate accurately
Asks a clear follow-up question about boarding time or direction

reviewTemplate.retrievalGoal: Recall how to confirm changed travel information and ask what happens next

storyTransition.entryContext: Lin Muen notices that her boarding gate has changed while waiting at the airport.
storyTransition.completionBeat: Lin Muen reaches the correct gate after the learner confirms the details with airport staff.

story.title: The Gate Has Changed
story.context: Lin Muen is waiting in the airport departure area when she sees that her gate may have changed.
story.mission: Help Lin Muen confirm the new gate and find out when boarding starts.

prerequisites: Understand common flight and gate details

dialogue.speaker: Lin Muen
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I think my boarding gate has changed. Could you help me check?

dialogue.speaker: Airport Agent
dialogue.text: Of course. Your flight now departs from Gate 24, and boarding begins at 3:20.

dialogue.speaker: Lin Muen
dialogue.text: So it is Gate 24, and I should be there before 3:20. Is it far from here?

dialogue.speaker: Airport Agent
dialogue.text: It is about a five-minute walk. Follow the signs to the right.

expressions.usage: Repeat important information to confirm it
Ask for the next important time
Ask whether extra travel time is needed

questions.prompt: What is Lin Muen's new boarding gate?

practice.prompt: Confirm Gate 24 and ask when boarding begins.
Your train platform changes. Confirm the new platform and departure time.

rolePlay.goal: Confirm a gate change and decide where to go next
rolePlay.openingLine: Hello. How can I help you?

reviewTasks.prompt: Without looking at the expressions, confirm a changed gate and ask when boarding starts.
reviewTasks.retrievalTarget: Confirm changed information and ask one next-step question

assets.generationPrompt: Create a realistic airport scene with Lin Muen standing full-body near a boarding gate, checking changed flight information and preparing to ask an airport agent. Natural light, clear environmental context, no readable text.
assets.altText: Lin Muen stands near an airport boarding gate and prepares to confirm changed flight details.

assets.generationPrompt: Generate a natural B1 airport conversation with two clearly distinct voices, neutral American English, realistic pace, short natural pauses, and no textbook-style delivery.
